Question 19
?

Find a Cartesian equation of the straight line that passes through P(0,−1,3) and is parallel to v=⟨2,3,−1⟩.

a
y−3−1=z+13,x=2
b
None of the listed
c
y−3−1=z+13,x=0
d
x2=y+13=z−3−1
e
x2=y3=z−1
Submit
